user.title: Home Insights
user.description: Record native HA notifications, Repairs and integration setup errors locally. Optionally select additional measured entity facts. Luma policies require an explicit import; AI reports are configured separately.

error.self_reference: Home Insights cannot monitor its own status entities.

init.title: Recorded entity state facts
init.description: Native HA sources are always recorded. These additional entities record measured state facts without creating custom alerts.

error.self_reference: Home Insights cannot monitor its own status entities.

get_daily_facts.name: Get daily facts
get_daily_facts.description: Read facts for a completed local calendar day. Defaults to yesterday. This action does not call AI or control devices. Admin users and native automations may request the private journal data.

date.name: Date
date.description: A completed date in the configured HA timezone.

policy_id.name: Policy ID
policy_id.description: Selects canonical policy facts. Omit for legacy native-source facts; these counts must not be added together.

set_attention_policy.name: Set attention policy
set_attention_policy.description: Import validated attention policy metadata; requires the current hash to replace an existing policy.

generate_report.name: Generate previous-day report
generate_report.description: Interpret canonical facts using a tool-free AI Task; persist attempt and successful result separately.

set_energy_profile.name: Set energy profile
set_energy_profile.description: Store explicit cumulative energy sources and comparison thresholds; replacing a profile requires its current hash.

get_energy_facts.name: Read daily energy facts
get_energy_facts.description: Read a completed local day and prior-day comparison from Recorder without AI or device actions.

generate_energy_report.name: Generate energy morning report
generate_energy_report.description: Persist deterministic energy totals and comparison, then ask a tool-free AI Task for a short interpretation.

set_heating_profile.name: Set heating profile
set_heating_profile.description: Recorded burner feedback, observation coverage and heating/hot-water classification. Short burns are a review heuristic, not a fault diagnosis.

get_heating_facts.name: Read daily burner facts
get_heating_facts.description: Recorded burner feedback, observation coverage and heating/hot-water classification. Short burns are a review heuristic, not a fault diagnosis.

generate_heating_report.name: Generate heating morning report
generate_heating_report.description: Recorded burner feedback, observation coverage and heating/hot-water classification. Short burns are a review heuristic, not a fault diagnosis.
